errors.title: Invalid/Missing District/School (WA06)
errors.description: WA06 must be a valid district/school identification number. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: District/School ID (WA06) invalid for the reporting district
errors.description: WA06 must be valid school code for the district reporting the EPIMS data.

errors.title: School ID code (WA06) required for school level job classification
errors.description: If Job Classification (WA07) is for a school position, then District/School ID (WA06) must be for a school. (1305, 1310, 1320, 2305, 2306, 2307, 2308, 2310, 2325, 3329, 3330, 3350, 3351, 3360, 3361, 3370, 3371, 4100, 5020, or 5021).

errors.title: Title I school (WA06) requires Title I staff to be reported
errors.description: If a school (WA06) is Title I Targeted Assistance, then at least one teacher or paraprofessional or an administrator must be reported with a Title I Federal salary source values in SR12 or SR14 or SR16 when SR09 is a working status.

errors.title: MEPID does not exist in EPIMS
errors.description: MEPID reported in WA01 not valid and does not exist in EPIMS.

errors.title: MEPID reported in SR01 is Inactive
errors.description: The MEPID reported in SR01 is inactive.

errors.title: MEPID does not exist in EPIMS
errors.description: MEPID reported in WA01 not valid and does not exist in EPIMS.

errors.title: MEPID Reported in WA01 is Inactive
errors.description: MEPID reported in Work Assignment record is not active.

errors.title: MEPID needs to be reported once in SR file
errors.description: For every MEPID that appears in a work assignment record, there should be EXACTLY ONE corresponding staff roster record containing that MEPID. This error checks the uniqueness and existence of the MEPID in the staff roster records submitted.

errors.title: Record reported more than once in SR file
errors.description: Duplicate MEPID in a staff roster file. There should be only one staff roster record per individual submitted by a district.

errors.title: Invalid Employee Number / Length must be 1--20 (SR02)
errors.description: SR02 must not be blank or null. If districts do not use a local employee number, the not applicable code of 0 must be used.

errors.title: Invalid Employee Number / Length must be 1--20 (WA02)
errors.description: WA02 must not be blank or null. If districts do not use a local employee number, a single alphanumeric symbol can be used in this field that is identical in all records, such as a 0.

errors.title: License Number (SR03) must match MEPID on file
errors.description: License number for a MEPID reported in the staff roster record must match the license number in ID Maintenance for that MEPID.

errors.title: Gender Missing on File
errors.description: Every MEPID reported in the Staff Roster file must have a Gender on file.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Race/Ethnicity (SR08)
errors.description: SR08 must be one of the valid codes for race/ethnicity listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: FN must match MEPID on file (SR)
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of first name (FN) associated with a MEPID in the SR record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: FN must match MEPID on file (WA)
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of first name (FN) associated with the MEPID in the WA record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: MN/MI must match MEPID on file (SR)
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of middle name/middle initial (MN/MI) associated with a MEPID in the SR record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: MN/MI must match MEPID on file (WA)
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of middle name/middle initial (MN/MI) associated with the MEPID in the WA record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: LN must match MEPID on file (SR)
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of last name (LN) associated with a MEPID in the SR record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: LN must match MEPID on file (WA)
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of last name (LN) associated with the MEPID in the WA record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: DOB must match MEPID on file
errors.description: The identifying characteristic of date of birth (DOB) associated with a non-exited MEPID in the SR record must match the identifying characteristic associated with the MEPID in ID Maintenance for current staff.

errors.title: Invalid format for Date of Birth (SR07)
errors.description: The format of SR07 must be mm/dd/yyyy.

errors.title: Date or Birth (SR07) cannot be less than 14 Years Old or More than 90 Years Old When Hired
errors.description: DOB cannot be less than 14 years old or more than 90 years old when hired.

errors.title: Degree Information Required
errors.description: If no license information is supplied, then degree information is required for this job classification.. (See EPIMS Appendix E for job classifications requiring degree information.)

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Degree Type 1 (SR18)
errors.description: SR18 must be one of the valid codes for degree type listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Degree Type 1 (SR18) not applicable. Invalid Degree Type 2 (SR21) and Degree Type 3 (SR24)
errors.description: If SR18 = 000, then SR21 and SR24 must equal 000. Fill in degree information in the fields for Degree Type 1 first, then 2, and then 3.

errors.title: Degree Type 1 (SR18) invalid with Degree Institution 1 (SR19) and Degree Subject 1 (SR20) (A)
errors.description: If SR18 = 000, 009, 010, 011, 012, or 013 then SR19 = 0000 and SR20 = 00. If the degree type information is not applicable, the corresponding institution and subject information is also not applicable.

errors.title: Degree Type 1 (SR18) invalid with Degree Institution 1 (SR19) and Degree Subject 1 (SR20) (B)
errors.description: If SR18 does not equal 000, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, or 013, then SR19 must not equal 0000 and SR20 must not equal 00. If there is degree type information entered (other than "not applicable"), there must be the corresponding institution and subject information also entered.

errors.title: Degree Type 2 (SR21) reported. Degree Type 1 (SR18) must be reported
errors.description: If SR21 is not 000, then SR18 must not equal 000. Fill in degree information in the fields for Degree Type 1 first, then 2, and then 3.

errors.title: Invalid Degree Institution 1 (SR19)
errors.description: SR19 must be one of the valid codes for degree institution listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Degree Subject 1 (SR20)
errors.description: SR20 must be one of the valid codes for degree subject listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Degree Type 2 (SR21)
errors.description: SR21 must be one of the valid codes for degree type listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Degree Type 2 (SR21) invalid with Degree Institution 2 (SR22) and Degree Subject 2 (SR23) (A)
errors.description: If SR21 = 000, 009, 010, 011, 012, or 013, then SR22 = 0000 and SR23 = 00. If the degree type information is not applicable, the corresponding institution and subject information is also not applicable.

errors.title: Degree Type 2 (SR21) invalid with Degree Institution 2 (SR22) and Degree Subject 2 (SR23) (B)
errors.description: If SR21 does not equal 000, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, or 013, then SR22 must not equal 0000 and SR23 must not equal 00. If there is degree type information entered (other than "not applicable"), there must be the corresponding institution and subject information also entered.

errors.title: Degree Type 3 (SR24) reported. Degree Type 2 (SR21) must be reported
errors.description: If SR24 is not 000, then SR21 must not equal 000. Fill in degree information in the fields for Degree Type 1 first, then 2, and then 3.

errors.title: Invalid Degree Institution 2 (SR22)
errors.description: SR22 must be one of the valid codes for degree institution listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Degree Subject 2 (SR23)
errors.description: SR23 must be one of the valid codes for degree subject listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Degree Type 3 (SR24)
errors.description: SR24 must be one of the valid codes for degree type listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Degree Type 3 (SR24) invalid with Degree Institution 3 (SR25) and Degree Subject 3 (SR26) (A)
errors.description: If SR24 = 000, 009, 010, 011, 012, or 013, then SR25 = 0000 and SR26 = 00. If the degree type information is not applicable, the corresponding institution and subject information is also not applicable.

errors.title: Degree Type 3 (SR24) invalid with Degree Institution 3 (SR25) and Degree Subject 3 (SR26) (B)
errors.description: Do not use Degree Type 3 (SR24), with Degree Institution 3 (SR25) or Degree Subject 3 *(SR26) (B).*

errors.title: Invalid Degree Institution 3 (SR25)
errors.description: SR25 must be one of the valid codes for degree institution listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Degree Subject 3 (SR26)
errors.description: SR26 must be one of the valid codes for degree subject listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Employment Status (SR09)
errors.description: SR09 must be one of the valid codes for employment status listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: No In-District Staff reported
errors.description: No staff was reported as being employed by the district (SR09=01).

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Reason for Exit (SR10)
errors.description: SR10 must be one of the valid codes for reason for exit listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Employee Status (SR09) not valid with Reason for Exit (SR10)
errors.description: SR09 must equal 04 if SR10 is not 00, and vice versa. If the employee has exited the district (SR09 = 04), then SR10 = 01--10. If the individual is employed (SR09 = 01--03), then SR10 = 00 (Not Applicable).

errors.title: - Invalid format for Date of Hire (SR11)
errors.description: The format for SR11 must be mm/dd/yyyy.

errors.title: Date of Hire (SR11) Can Not be Less Than or Equal to Date of Birth (SR07)
errors.description: SR11 cannot be less than or equal to SR07.

errors.title: Date of Hire (SR11) must be on or prior to the EOY close date
errors.description: The date of hire for a staff member must be prior to the collection closing date. Report future hires in the following collection.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Fed Sal Source 1 (SR12)
errors.description: SR12 must be one of the valid codes for federal salary source listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Inaccurate Grant Code (SR12, SR14, or SR16) reported
errors.description: The grant code reported in (SR12, SR14, or SR16) must represent a federal grant allocation that the district is receiving.

errors.title: Invalid Percent Federal Salary Source1 (SR13)
errors.description: SR13 is a numeric value equal to or less than 1.00. It requires a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 5 characters, including a decimal point, and must not be blank or null. If not applicable, the acceptable code is 00.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 1 (SR12) reported. Invalid Percent of Federal Salary Source 1 (SR13)
errors.description: If SR12 is not 000, then SR13 must contain a percent greater than 0. SR13 must not equal 00 (Not Applicable) or be blank or null. If a Federal Grant code is entered, there must be a percent entered also.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 1 (SR12) not reported. Invalid SR13--SR17
errors.description: If SR12 = 000, then all the subsequent Federal Salary Source and percent Federal Salary Source fields (SR13--SR17) must be not applicable. If there is no Federal Grant code entered in the first option for a Federal Salary Source, then there is no Federal Salary Source information to be reported.

errors.title: Sum of Federal Salary Percent (SR13 + SR15 + SR17) cannot be greater than 100%
errors.description: The sum of the sources of an individual's salary cannot exceed 1.00.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Fed Sal Source 2 (SR14)
errors.description: SR14 must be one of the valid codes for federal salary source listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 2 (SR14) reported. Invalid Federal Salary Source 1 (SR12)
errors.description: If SR14 does not equal 000, then SR12 must not equal 000. Federal Salary information should be entered in Federal Salary Source 1, then 2, then 3.

errors.title: Inaccurate Grant Code (SR12, SR14, or SR16) reported
errors.description: The grant code reported in (SR12, SR14, or SR16) must represent a federal grant allocation that the district is receiving.

errors.title: Invalid Percent Federal Salary Source2 (SR15)
errors.description: SR15 is a numeric value equal to or less than 1.00. It requires a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 5 characters, including a decimal point, and must not be blank or null. If not applicable, the acceptable code is 00.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 2 (SR14) reported. Invalid Percent of Federal Salary Source 2 (SR15)
errors.description: If SR14 does not equal 000, then SR15 must not equal 00 (Not Applicable) or be blank or null. If a Federal Grant code is entered, there must also be a percent entered.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 2 (SR14) not reported. Invalid SR15--SR17
errors.description: If SR14 = 000 then SR15, SR16, and SR17 must be not applicable. If there is no Federal Grant code in SR14, there should not be a percentage in the corresponding Percent of Federal Salary Source 2 (SR15) or any Federal Salary Source information in the 3^rd^ group of fields (SR16 and SR17).

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Fed Sal Source 3 (SR16)
errors.description: SR16 must be one of the valid codes for federal salary source listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 3 (SR16) reported. Invalid Federal Salary Source 2 (SR14)
errors.description: If there is a Federal Salary Source reported in the third source field (SR16), there should be a source reported in the second source field (SR14). If SR14 = 000 (Not Applicable), so should SR16.

errors.title: If SR12/ SR14/ SR16 are reported then SR12 must not equal SR14 and SR14 must not equal SR16
errors.description: Federal Salary sources must not be duplicated in a record. The first code for Federal Salary Source (SR12) should not be repeated in the second (SR14) or third (SR16) data elements for Federal Salary Source.

errors.title: Inaccurate Grant Code (SR12, SR14, or SR16) reported
errors.description: The grant code reported in (SR12, SR14, or SR16) must represent a federal grant allocation that the district is receiving.

errors.title: Invalid Percent Federal Salary Source3 (SR17)
errors.description: SR17 is a numeric value equal to or less than 1.00. It requires a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 5 characters, including a decimal point, and must not be blank or null. If not applicable, the acceptable code is 00.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 3 (SR16) reported. Invalid Percent of Federal Salary Source 3 (SR17)
errors.description: If SR16 does not equal 000, then SR17 must not equal 00 (Not Applicable) or be blank or null. If a Federal Grant code is entered, there must also be a percent entered.

errors.title: Federal Salary Source 3 (SR16) not reported. Invalid Percent of Federal Salary Source 3 (SR17)
errors.description: If SR16 = 000, then SR17 must equal 00. If a Federal Salary Source is entered as not applicable, the corresponding percent of that Federal Salary Source must also be not applicable.

errors.title: Invalid Date of Exit (SR27). A date must be entered or NA if not applicable
errors.description: SR27 must be formatted as mm/dd/yyyy if a date in reported. Otherwise, NA must be reported.

errors.title: Date of Exit (SR27) must not be reported for employed staff
errors.description: If Employment Status (SR09) does not indicate an exit (not equal to '04'), then an exit date should not be reported and NA should be reported in SR27.

errors.title: Date of Exit (SR27) must be reported for exited staff
errors.description: If Employment Status (SR09) indicates an exit (equal to '04'), then an exit date should be reported and must not equal NA.

errors.title: Date of Exit (SR27) for exited staff must be between the Date of Hire (SR11) and the date of collection.
errors.description: For exited staff, SR27 must be between the Date of Hire (SR11) and the date of collection (usually October 1 or the last day of school) inclusive.

errors.title: Invalid District Level Educator's Professional Teacher Status (SR28)
errors.description: SR28 must be one of the valid codes for Educator's Professional Teacher Status listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null

errors.title: Not Applicable must be reported in Educators Professional Teacher Status (SR28) for Charter Schools
errors.description: For all Charter Schools, SR28 must be "Not Applicable".

errors.title: If the Overall Evaluation is non-administrative, then Professional Teacher Status cannot be NA (99)
errors.description: If a staff member in a public district has been evaluated as a non-administrator then the value of SR28 cannot be 99.

errors.title: SR29 through SR33 must be "Not Applicable" where no Work Assignment records have been reported
errors.description: For educators who have no Work Assignments in the EOY collection, SR29 through SR33 must be "Not Applicable".

errors.title: Educator's Professional Teacher Status (SR28) must be "Not Applicable" where Job Classifications do not require a License
errors.description: For educators *whose only* job classifications are ones that do not require an ESE license, SR28 must be "Not Applicable".

errors.title: Invalid Educator's Professional Teacher Status (SR28)/ Admin
errors.description: For educators with job classifications that require an ESE license and *whose positions are only administrative*, SR28 must be "Not Applicable".

errors.title: Teachers must report Professional Teacher Status (SR28)
errors.description: In EOY, in non-Charter Public School Districts, for educators with job classifications that require an ESE license and *whose positions are non-administrative*, SR28 may not be "Not Applicable" (99).

errors.title: All individuals reported as active in the previous collection must have a staff roster record in current collection
errors.description: If SR09 = 01, 02, 03 or 05 for the previous reporting period, the individual must be reported in the SR file for the current collection period. If they have since exited, they should be reported as SR09 = 04.

errors.title: Exited Staff (SR09=04) that worked in current school year must have at least one work assignment record
errors.description: If a staff member is reported as exited (SR09=04) in the current period, then s/he must have at least one work assignment if they worked in current school year.

errors.title: SR Record missing for WA record
errors.description: The MEPID has a work assignment, but not a staff roster record. All reported staff must have a staff roster record.

errors.title: Overall rating (SR29) cannot be proficient or exemplary if standard 1 and/or 2 (SR30 and SR31) rating is \"needs improvement\"
errors.description: Overall rating (SR29) cannot be proficient or exemplary if standard 1 and/or 2 (SR30 and SR31) rating is \"needs improvement\"

errors.title: Overall Summative Rating (SR29) invalid with Standard (1) Rating(s) (SR30 / Administrators)
errors.description: Overall Summative Rating (SR29) and Standards Ratings must be all administrator codes, not teacher codes

errors.title: District is identified with staff attendance rate of 98.0% or higher. Please reach out to Data Collection Support.
errors.description: Please review the attendance data. If the staff attendance is correct, please reach out to Data Collection for an exception.

errors.title: District is identified with staff attendance rate lower than 90.0%. Please reach out to Data Collection Support.
errors.description: Please review the attendance data. If the staff attendance is correct, please reach out to the Data Collection for an exception.

errors.title: Exited staff with work assignments should not have 0 Expected Days of Attendance
errors.description: If a staff member has work assignments in current school year, they should not have 0 expected days of attendance in SR37.

errors.title: Missing Subject Area--Course (WA10)
errors.description: WA10 must be a valid subject area--course code listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid Subject Area/Course (WA10) code
errors.description: WA10 must be one of the valid codes for subject area/course listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Invalid CIP (WA10) code
errors.description: If the educator teaches in a Chapter 74--approved program, the subject area/course code (WA10) should be a seven-digit CIP code listed in the subject area/course codes found in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It should not be a five-digit NCES/EPIMS code, also found in the subject area/course code list.

errors.title: District not approved for CIP program
errors.description: WA10 must be the seven-digit (CIP) code if the vocational teacher is teaching in a Chapter 74--approved program. If the school is not Chapter 74--approved, the vocational teacher's courses must be coded with the five-digit EPIMS/NCES codes.

errors.title: Prior-to-Secondary Course Code (WA10) required for Grade (WA09) reported
errors.description: If WA09 = PK, K, 01, K01, 0102, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, or 08, then prior-to-secondary course code must be reported.

errors.title: Secondary Course Code (WA10) required for Grade (WA09) reported
errors.description: If WA09 = 09, 10, 11, or 12, then secondary course code must be reported.

errors.title: Subject Area-Course (WA10) not valid for Work Assignment (WA08)** (A)
Subject Area-Course (WA10) not valid for Work Assignment (WA08) (B)
errors.description: If WA08 = 010, then WA10 must equal 51008.

errors.title: Prior-to-Secondary Course Code (WA10) required for Assignment (WA08)
errors.description: If WA08 = 001, 010, 014, 212 or 301, then a prior-to-secondary course code must be reported.

errors.title: Secondary Course Code (WA10) required for Assignment (WA08)
errors.description: If WA08 = 002, 011, 020, 208, 302, 303 or 213 then a secondary course code must be reported.

errors.title: Subject Area-Course (WA10) not valid for Work Assignment (WA08) and Job Classification (WA07)
errors.description: If WA07=2305, 2306, 2307, 2308, 2310 or 2325 and WA08 is a non-core assignment, then subject area course code (WA10) must not be 00000.

errors.title: Non Instructional Paraprofessionals (WA08) must have 00000 for a Course Code (WA10)
errors.description: Non-instructional paraprofessionals (WA08=406) must have N/A for a Course Code (WA10 = 00000).

errors.title: All Subjects course code (WA10=99999) is only valid for secondary SPED or ELL work assignments
All subjects course code (WA10=99999) is not valid for virtual classrooms
errors.description: If WA10=99999, then WA07 must not be virtual (2307, 2308).

errors.title: All subjects course code (WA10=99999) is not valid for prior-to-secondary classes
errors.description: If WA10=99999, then grade (WA09) must be 09 to 12 or 88 or 99.

errors.title: Prior-to-Secondary Education Class WA10= 73039 must use a multiple grade code (WA09)
errors.description: The course code (WA10) of 73039 is to be used for general education classes which cannot be differentiated by a single grade level. When reported, the value of WA09 must be K01, 0102, 88 or 99. When there is a predominant grade in a general education classroom, use the grade specific codes 73029 through 73038.

errors.title: Tutors (WA07=3323) must have N/A values for Grade (WA09), Subject Area-Course (WA10), Class Section (WA11)
errors.description: Tutors may not be reported with specific courses, grades or sections.

errors.title: MEPID (WA01)/Job Classification (WA07)/Assignment (WA08)/Course (WA10)/Section (WA11)/ Course Term (WA16) combination must be unique within School (WA06)
errors.description: Determines uniqueness of a Work Assignment Record within a school by the combination of MEPID, Job Classification, Assignment, Subject Area/Course, Class Section and Course Term.

errors.title: Secondary Core Subject Area-Course Code (WA10) for Job Classification (WA07=2305, 2306, 2307, or 2308) must have multiple WA records & FTE (WA12) must be less than 1.0 per course term
errors.description: If WA07=2305, 2306, 2307, or 2308 and WA10 is a secondary, core subject area-course code and does not equal CIP Code, then there must be more than one Work Assignment record and WA12 must be less than 1.0 per record per course term.

errors.title: Days of Attendance must be between 0 and 261
errors.description: Days of Attendance (SR36) must be between 0 and 261 in EOY and for exited staff. In October, a value of 999 (not applicable) may be reported for working staff.

errors.title: Working Staff may not have 0 Days of Attendance.
errors.description: A staff member reported as working and not on leave (SR09=01 or 05) must not be reported with 0 days of attendance.

errors.title: Days of Attendance (SR36) has invalid format
errors.description: Days of attendance must be numeric

errors.title: Expected Days of Attendance must be less than 261 days.
errors.description: Expected Days of Attendance (SR37) must be less than 261 days in EOY and for exited staff. In October, a value of 999 (not applicable) may be reported for working staff.

errors.title: Exited staff may not report NA (999) for days of attendance or expected days (may report 0)
errors.description: Staff reported as exited must report applicable days of attendance and expected attendance. A value of zero (0) may be reported for staff who exit between school years.

errors.title: Expected Days of Attendance must be greater than or equal to Days in Attendance
errors.description: The value of SR37 (Expected Days of Attendance) must not be less than the Days of Attendance.

errors.title: SR36 Staff Days of Attendance exceeds maximum for collection period. Attendance Days value cannot exceed 65 days in October Collection.
errors.description: The value of SR36 (Days of Attendance) must not exceed 65 days in October

errors.title: SR37 Staff Expected Days of Attendance exceeds maximum for collection period. Expected Attendance Days value cannot exceed 65 days in October Collection
errors.description: The value of SR37 (Expected Days of Attendance) must not exceed 65 days in October

errors.title: Working Staff may not have 0 Expected Days of Attendance.
errors.description: A staff member reported as working and not on leave (SR09=01) must not be reported with 0 expected days of attendance.

errors.title: Expected Days of Attendance (SR37) is not consistent with the Termination date (SR27)
errors.description: The number of days between the hire and termination date of a staff member should be consistent with working a standard 5 day work week.

errors.title: Invalid Beginner Educator Identifier (SR38)
errors.description: SR38 must be one of the valid codes for Beginner Educator Identifier found in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Staff has experience in primary job classification and so may not be reported as a beginning educator in SR38.
errors.description:
If a staff member has recorded over a year in a reported job classification, then s/he may not be reported as a beginning educator for that classification.

For the purposes of this validation, teaching classifications are combined into one; so '2305', \'2306\', \'2307\', \'2308\',\'2310\' and \'2325\' are all considered to be the same.

errors.title: Invalid/Missing Job Classification (WA07)
errors.description: WA07 must be a valid job classification code listed in the EPIMS Data Handbook. It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Job Classification (WA07) not valid with Grade (WA09) and should be reported at the school level in District/School ID (WA06)
errors.description: If WA07 = 1305, 1310, 1320, 3329, 3330, 3350, 3351, 3360, 3361, 3370, 3371, 5020, or 5021, then WA06 must equal a school code (the last four digits of the eight-digit number must not be 0000) and WA09 must equal 00.

errors.title: Job Classification (WA07) not valid with Grade (WA09) and should be reported at the district level in District/School ID (WA06)
errors.description: If WA07 = 1200, 1201, 1202, 1205, 1211, 1212 or 1226 then the WA06 must equal a district code (the last four digits of the eight-digit number must be 0000) and the WA09 must equal 00.

errors.title: Job Classification (WA07=1312) must be reported at the school level (WA06)
errors.description: If WA07=1312 (School Special Education Administrator), then WA06 must be a school code.

errors.title: Working Staff (SR09=01) must have at least one work assignment record reported in an active term (WA17=01)
errors.description: If SR09 = 01, must have at least one work assignment record in an active term. If the employee is working, their MEPID must be reported at least once in a work assignment file.

errors.title: Superintendent Job Classification (WA07) required/must be one and only one WA record reported for your district
errors.description: There must be exactly one work assignment record in a single active period reported with WA07 = 1200 for each school district for active records (SR09=01), including charter and Collaborative school districts.

errors.title: Principal Job Classification (WA07) required
errors.description: There must be one or more work assignment record for all active periods reported with WA07 = 1305 for each school or charter or collaborative school for active records (SR09=01).

errors.title: Special Education Administrator Job Classification (WA07) required/must be one and only one WA record reported for your district
errors.description: There must be exactly one work assignment record in a single active period reported with WA07 = 1212 for each school district, collaborative and charter school for active records (SR09=01).

errors.title: Only one working Teaching assignment (WA07=2305, 2307 or 2325) may be reported for a class
errors.description: For any unique combination of School (WA06), Course (WA10), Section (WA11) and Term (WA16), only one working (SR09=01) solo teacher (WA07=2305, 2307 or 2325) can be reported. If multiple teachers are assigned to a course, then they must be reported as Co-Teachers (WA07=2306 or 2308).

errors.description: SR29 must be one of the valid codes for Educator's current school year overall Summative Evaluation rating or Formative Evaluation rating listed in . It must not be blank or null.

errors.title: Evaluation Fields (SR29-SR33) must either be all N/A (99) or all valid evaluation codes.
errors.description: SR29 through SR33 must reflect a consistent standard. If a staff member is not subject to reportable evaluation then all standards must be NA. If a staff member is subject to reportable evaluation then all evaluation standards must be not NA (99).

errors.title: Ratings must be all Summative

errors.title: Ratings must be all Formative

errors.title: Overall Summative Rating (SR29) invalid with Standard Rating(s) (SR30-SR33)
errors.description: For educators with job classifications that require an ESE license, if SR30 through SR33 is not 00, then SR29 must not be 00.

errors.title: Summative/Formative Evaluation Rating (SR29) must be "Not Applicable" where Job Classifications do not require a License
errors.description: For educators *whose only* job classifications are ones that do not require an ESE license in the EOY collection, SR29 must be "Not Applicable".

errors.title: Invalid Evaluation Rating (SR29) -- Check that evaluation date is in current calendar year.
errors.description: In EOY, for educators with job classifications require a DESE license, SR29 must not be "Not Applicable" with these exceptions: For 1205 (Other District Wide Administrators), 1208 (Human Resources Director), 1224 (Supervisor/Director/Coordinator: Technology) and 1320 (Other School Administrator/ Coordinator) an evaluation is optional and may report N/A (99). For 2325 (Long Term Substitute teachers) who are employed for less than 3 months, districts may report N/A (99) in this field. Commonwealth Charter Schools and collaboratives may report N/A (99) for all staff regardless of license requirements.

errors.title: Overall Summative Rating (SR29) invalid with Standard (1) and/or Standard (2) Rating(s) (SR30-SR31) /Non-Administrators
errors.description: For staff whose licensed job classifications are only non-administrative positions, SR30 and SR31 must be 13 through 20 if SR29 is 13 through 20.

errors.title: Overall Summative Rating (SR29) invalid with Standard (1) Rating(s) (SR30 /Administrators

errors.title: Administrators may only be evaluated with administrative ratings.
errors.description: In the EOY collection, if a staff member who is subject to evaluation has no non-administrative work assignments then their Ratings (SR29-SR33) cannot be non-administrative ratings.

errors.title: Non-Administrators may only be evaluated with non-administrative ratings.
errors.description: In the EOY collection, if a staff member who is subject to evaluation has no administrative work assignments then their Ratings (SR29-SR33) cannot be administrative ratings.

errors.title: EOY Non-Administrative Rating in SR29 may not be re-characterized as Administrative in October
errors.description: Staff evaluation data reported in October must be consistent in that a teacher rating can only be corrected to be a different teacher rating

errors.title: EOY Administrative Rating in SR29 may not be re-characterized as Non-Administrative in October
errors.description: Staff evaluation data reported in October must be consistent in that an administrative or "not evaluated" rating can only be corrected to be a different administrative rating

errors.title: Evaluation data may only be reported in October if it is an update to EOY data.
errors.description: Staff evaluation data reported in October must be different than that reported in EOY. The staff member must have been subject to evaluation in the EOY collection.

errors.title: A \"Not Evaluated\" rating for SR29 may only be reported in October if it is an update to EOY evaluation data.

errors.title: Invalid Standard (2) Evaluation Rating (SR31)

SIF Validations

In addition to the EPIMS validations mentioned, LEAs submitting their EPIMS data via SIF will have their data validated with some enhanced rules. These are designed to assist in diagnosing the cause of certain errors as well enhance the quality of the data by utilizing data elements which are unavailable to those submitting via flat file.

## SIF1105 - SchoolCourseInfo SchoolInfoRefId is missing

Object: SchoolCourseInfo

Element: SchoolInfoRefId

A SchoolCourseInfo object has been received which references a school for which a SchoolInfo object has not been received.

## SIF1117 - SchoolInfo LeaInfoRefId is missing

Object: SchoolInfo

Element: LEAInfoRefId

A SchoolInfo object has been received which with a missing LEAInfoRefId element.

## SIF1118 - SchoolInfo LeaInfoRefId is unknown

Object: SchoolInfo

Element: LEAInfoRefId

A SchoolInfo object has been received which with an invalid LEAInfoRefId element.

## SIF1119 - TermInfo SchoolInfoRefId is missing

Object: TermInfo

Element: SchoolInfoRefId

A TermInfo object has been received with no SchoolInfoRefId.

## SIF1120 - TermInfo SchoolInfoRefId is unknown

Object: TermInfo

Element: SchoolInfoRefId

A TermInfo object has been received which references a school for which a SchoolInfo object has not been received.

## SIF1141 - Invalid/Missing Leave Start Date

Object: EmploymentRecord

Element: LeaveStartDate

Leave Start Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD standard SIF format.

## SIF1142 - LeaveStartDate value cannot be blank when SR09 is 02 or 03.

Object: EmploymentRecord

Element: LeaveStartDate

If SR09 employment status is 02 or 03 (on leave), then LeaveStartDate must be populated

## SIF1143 - SR09 cannot be 01 or 05 when LeaveStartDate value is prior to collection start date.

## Object: EmploymentRecord

Element: LeaveStartDate

If LeaveStartDate is populated, then the SR09 employment status value should be 02 or 03 (on leave).

## SIF1164 - StaffAssignment missing StaffPersonal

Object: StaffAssignment

Element: StaffPersonalRefId

No StaffPersonal record can be found for a submitted StaffAssignment record.

## SIF1165 - StaffSectionAssignment missing StaffPersonal

Object: StaffSectionAssignment

Element: StaffInfoRefId

A StaffSectionAssignment object has been received which references a staff for whom a StaffPersonal object has not been received.

## SIF1166 - Teaching StaffAssignment missing StaffSectionAssignment with matching role

Object: StaffAssignment

Element: StaffAssignment/JobFuntion/OtherCode & StaffSectionAssignment/Role

A StaffSectionAssignment object has not been received with a teaching role to match a StaffAssignment with a teaching function.

## SIF1167 - Multiple primary assignments

Object: StaffAssignment

Element: StaffAssignment/PrimaryAssignment

Only one active StaffAssignment may have the PrimaryAssignment flag set to Yes.

## SIF1169 - StaffPersonal missing StaffAssignment

Object: StaffAssignment

Element: StaffPersonalRefId

No StaffAssignment can be found for a staff member's StaffPersonal record.

## SIF1170 - StaffSectionAssignment missing StaffAssignment with matching JobFunction

Object: StaffSectionAssignment

Element: Roles/Role

StaffSectionAssignments must have a corresponding StaffAssignment with a JobFunction which matches the role reported.

## SIF1172 - EmploymentRecord missing LEAInfo

Object: EmploymentRecord

Element: LEAInfoRefId

An EmploymentRecord object has been received which with a missing LEAInfoRefId element.

## SIF1188 - SectionInfo with StudentSectionEnrollments but no StaffSectionAssignments

Object: StaffSectionAssignment

Element: SectionInfoRefId

A StaffSectionAssignment object has not been received which references a SectionInfo object, implying that there is no teacher for the section.

## SIF1189 - SectionInfo with StaffSectionAssignments but no StudentSectionEnrollments

Object: SectionInfo

Element: StudentSectionEnrollment/SectionInfoRefId

A staffed course section exists, but no students have been enrolled in it.

Term Definitions Table  ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Term Definition --------------- ------------------------------------------------------- Full school A regular school term consisting of no major year subdivision of time segments. It usually begins in the late summer or early fall and ends in late spring or early summer (e.g., elementary school).  Intersession A short session which occurs between longer sessions.  Mini-term A school term which is shorter than a regular session.  Quarter One of four equal segments into which a school year is divided.  Quinmester One of five equal segments into which a school year is divided.  Semester One of two equal segments into which a school year is divided.  Summer term A school term which takes place in the summer between two regular school terms.  Trimester One of three equal segments into which a school year is divided. -----------------------------------------------------------------------  All non-instructional staff should be reported as code 01 -- FULL  Reporting Courses that Span Multiple Terms  Districts should use the "X" term codes (codes 34, 45, 56, and 68) when the length of the course consists of multiple terms, but does not constitute a full year course.  Example: A school's course schedule primarily uses trimesters, but the Advanced Economics course is two trimesters long. In this case, the Course Term for Advanced Economics should be reported as code 34 -- TRIX to indicate that the course covers multiple trimesters.  Reporting Courses that Span Multiple Non-consecutive Terms  Districts should use the "N" term codes (codes 35, 46, 57, and 69) when the length of the course consists of multiple non-consecutive terms, and does not constitute a full year course.  Example: A school's course schedule primarily uses trimesters. The World Cultures course is two trimesters long, but is in session during trimesters 1 and 3. In this case, the Course Term for World Cultures should be reported as code 35 -- TRIN to indicate that the course covers multiple non-consecutive trimesters.

fields.description: The two-digit code that identifies a course term as either active or inactive at the time of the data collection. Inactive terms are terms that have already been held and completed.
fields.acceptable_values: 01 = Active Term  02 = Inactive Term  03 = Inactive Assignment
fields.notes: The term status for the last term of a collection year should be reported as active in the EPIMS June EOY collection even though the course enrollment status for the course in the SCS collection will be reported as "completed" for the corresponding subject-area course and term reported in the SCS. The last term of the year may be a full year term, a fourth quarter term, or any other term that is active until the end of the academic school year.  01 = Active Term -- Use this code to indicate that the assignment is active and that the term is also active or was active at end of year.  02 = Inactive Term - Use this code to indicate that the assignment was active at the end of the term and that the term has completed (except for EOY).  03 = Inactive Assignment - Use this code to indicate that the educator was not active in this assignment at the time of the report or at the end of the term if it was in the past.
